quest.title: Bell Ringing at Dusk
quest.description: The ritual is not yet complete. Better stop Pavlina before that happens...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: I-Is that lightning... frozen solid!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, remember what Aglaya told us? On the day Larisa died, the blizzard raised by her fury could freeze even bolts of lightning mid-fall. Could this be what she meant...?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Then it seems the final site of the "ritual" lies at the summit... above the clouds.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa... {NICKNAME}, watch your step on the way up, okay? And if you can't help looking down, Paimon will cover your eyes for you!

talks.objective: Use the power of the Rumblebranch to get up

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: The two of you were not invited.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: But I have an invite on me.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: An invite... I see. Though the two of you weren't meant to be invited, this altered fate has named you intruders all the same.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: What would Koshchei say if he were here...? He would say, "Something like this was bound to happen."

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: But the bow has already been drawn, and the arrow is set. Fate has carried us here, and there is no turning away from it now.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: ...I'm finally free. You have taught me all I know, Pavlina, and the ins and outs of your traps are no news to me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Where did you come from...?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Never mind that for now. The ritual mustn't continue. "His" power mustn't be sacrificed this way... And once we accomplish that, I have a score to settle with her too.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Pavlina...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She... disappeared!?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: But she did not vanish entirely, for she has left this. The union ritual is complete. It's just that she did not manage to offer up that power...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: And that is why the parts of my body that were fragmentized and then fragmentized again re-crystallized after the ritual.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That is correct. It is fortunate that we managed to stop Pavlina. She... was so close to success.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Here, take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: This is the Eye of Graeae... Or rather, what was originally a part of the Eye of Graeae's body.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you sure you want to give this to us? Also... Hmm. Tell us, why did you want to stop that Snegurochka princess?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Because you and I share the same purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Oh, that's right. Though I already know who you are, I suppose I have yet to formally introduce myself to you...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I am but a lowly "Court Jester" who once served His Majesty, the late Belyi Tsar. My name, insignificant as it is, is Aksinya.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: Aksinya...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Yes. Does that serve to refresh your memory?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Izmaylo is always complaining that my introductions are far too humble. But personally? I just see it as a deliberate choice of style.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: "Aksinya"... That name sounds very familiar.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Well, that happens to be the name of the person who built the mechanism you're residing in right now, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You... are the one who made Goggles?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Yes, that is I.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Haha, so you see, "Goggles" belongs to me. Do be good and return it now, you little thieves!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huhhhhh????

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I'm only teasing. Feel free to keep "him" with you.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: In that grand design, it was also I who was supposed to obtain the Eye of Graeae along with the will inside it. But since "he" has made "his" choice...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I believe in the Eye of Graeae, and I also believe in you, the ones "he" has chosen.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That's enough of an introduction. Our goal is the same... to help the will inside the Eye of Graeae find its body and reclaim its power.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: So, what exactly is this "power"?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: ...Have you forgotten even what it is you wish to reclaim? Do you remember nothing but the will to recover what is yours...? It is a thought that gives one pause. But I suppose it serves the purpose for which the plan was first devised.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Your power, your body, they were created so that "life may transcend life itself."

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: And that is also why Pavlina sought to steal your power... A number of the fae were originally servants created by the Hyperboreans. They were never perfect creations...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: The Snegovik can only achieve completion and perfection through rituals. And what better than a ritual with an offering that would allow the Snegovik here to transcend as well?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: That was what Pavlina was trying to do...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: She sought to cast off the shackles placed upon her at the time of creation... The truth was, however, that because her existence was incomplete, she could only draw upon "his" power by performing one ritual after another, endlessly...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Though she is a Snegurochka princess, and thus among the mightiest of the fae, these ceaseless rituals nevertheless brought great pain to both her mind and will.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And... you said that she was close to success regardless!?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: A success for her would have been the greatest defeat for the world.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: The "tomorrow" she has in mind is a tomorrow where her people could become whole. This, perhaps, is how she loves them.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: But for the rest of the world, using such power for a purpose like that would be nothing short of a waste... It is fortunate that we were able to recover it before she could do so.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's... Paimon feels a little bad for those Snegovik now.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: ...Pity is a conceit born of arrogance and self-importance. Perhaps those Snegovik have no need to be pitied, nor for her so-called love.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon supposes you could be right...

choices.text: But that doesn't mean that everything she's done is wrong...

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: Perhaps. And her people certainly do not have the right to condemn her.

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: But for the world... Her love is one confined to too small a circle.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Tsk. All this sounds so complicated. Can love really be too great or too limited...?

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: Some would say yes, and others would say no. Yet this is what I believe: a love capable of saving more lives is a love all the greater, and all the more noble.

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: So... What would I become if I recovered all my power? Would I then be... strong enough... to save everyone?

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: That would depend on the choice "you" make when the time comes.

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: Very well. Since we share the same purpose, I am certain we shall meet again... Until that day...

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: There is much that remains for us all to do.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's gone... How's it going with you, Goggles? Now that you've recovered some of your power, do you remember anything new?

response.speaker: Eye of Graeae
response.text: A few things. But they're... only vague impressions for now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh... Okay then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's alright. She did say we'll see her again later anyway... So, when we do, we'll just make her tell us everything!

choices.text: She did all she could, and gave all she had...

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: Yes. And that is precisely why this is the most sorrowful part of all for her — no, for all of us who dwell in this world. There comes a certain time when one realizes that...

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: "You would do the same, had you possessed the means to save the world with your love." Yet no one possesses a love so great, nor so noble.

response.speaker: Aksinya
response.text: Even one such as Pavlina can only bestow her "love" upon those within her reach — her people, her kin. Yet the love of the individual is far too limited.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: You took "his" power away from me, just for the sake of your people... But are they really worth it? Are they really worth betraying that world His Majesty has promised?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: We should have had a better future.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: His people are my responsibility, my burden to shoulder...

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: A better future? It might have been so for you. But for us, that would just have become yet another prison.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: Aksinya, you seek a "tomorrow," a place of eternal joy and flow, and a world of everlasting love. But what about us fae and those without love?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: They... will be reborn in a new courtyard.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: No, Aksinya, they won't. Both you and I know full well that the cycle has run its course and there will not be new civilizations henceforth.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: There will be new creation no more. All that remains to us is the sifting and remaking.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: The door is one that we will... never pass. It is but a pageant leading to the executioner's blade.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: ...Yet I must, for the sake of my friend who perished in pursuit of that absurd notion of "love" — for her sake alone... seek a way that even my people may find meaning in lives born of artifice.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: But it appears that this isn't something all of your people can comprehend... Pavlina, you say that they are your responsibility and your burden. It may well be likewise for them — I'm speaking of the burden part.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: ...The ones who love, and the ones who are loved, will always be burdens to each other.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: But how about you, Aksinya? Have you ever given "him" a chance to choose "his" path?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: ..."He" will come to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Once upon a time... you told me that they do not know what is best for them. But I must say, you are no different than them.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: Perhaps we are all so.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: A price has to be paid for that "tomorrow" that should come. A price, and a sacrifice.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: We have all chosen the paths that we thought were the best. As for where those will lead us to... is not something I can predict.

dialogues.speaker: Pavlina
dialogues.text: You have won this time, Aksinya... Go on. Claim the spoils of your victory...

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: I am aware of that. But I have never hoped for your loss... Pavlina.

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: Pavlina...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She... disappeared!?

dialogues.speaker: Aksinya
dialogues.text: But she did not vanish entirely, for she has left this. The union ritual is complete. It's just that she did not manage to offer up that power...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And so we've found the first body fragment... Hmm. Let's get ourselves to the other spot Goggles marked next.

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: The approximate area has been marked out for you. I will be beyond grateful if you could go there for a look.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That lightning she's drawing down won't come crashing down on us, will it...?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: It very well might. Please be careful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm. Isn't that another... ice branch that draws lightning? Then why isn't any lightning coming down?

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: It appears this ice branch is incomplete. We need to find the smaller branches growing out from it...

dialogues.speaker: Eye of Graeae
dialogues.text: There are two in total... I've marked them on the map for you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? We've gotta go that high up...?
